test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Conditions such as stress, depression and anxiety can all affect mental health and _________ a person’s routine.
solution:
The correct answer is “**disrupt**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "disrupt" accurately describes how mental health conditions like stress, depression, and anxiety can interfere with or hinder someone's daily activities or routine.
 
• These conditions often cause disturbances in normal functioning, making it challenging for individuals to maintain their usual pace in life. 
 
• In the context of the given sentence, "disrupt" perfectly fits as it conveys the idea of an interruption or disturbance to a normal process or state. Mental health issues often lead to such disruptions, affecting various aspects of a person’s life, including work, relationships, and personal well-being.

Hence, the correct answer is ‘**Option 4’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• **Fragment**: To break something into smaller parts or pieces. (टुकड़ों में तोड़ना)
 
• **Crush**: To press or squeeze with force so that it becomes flat, soft, or out of shape. (कुचलना)
 
• **Dishevel**: To make untidy; to mess up. (बिखेरना)
